metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for managing Coronium.io mobile proxies.

plugins.name: coronium-mobile-proxies
plugins.description: Check, rotate and connect the dedicated 4G/5G mobile proxies you rent from Coronium.io. This plugin does not spend: spending is off by default, and buying needs the server's buyer profile with CORONIUM_ENABLE_SPENDING=1 and an exact-total confirmation.
